purpose: Acquisition authority and coverage evidence for Minnesota physical-grid classes. This ledger records source availability, not an inventory of physical assets and not statewide completeness.
truth_boundary: A source marked unavailable, restricted, denied, or candidate closes only that acquisition attempt. It neither changes the physical class to complete nor permits inferred assets, geometry, terminals, or connectivity.

source_records.publisher: Minnesota Geospatial Information Office / Minnesota Public Utilities Commission
source_records.authority: Official statewide electric utility service-area map; the PUC describes it as the official map under its April 9, 2014 Order in Docket 12-957.
source_records.license_or_terms: No reusable license statement was returned by the service metadata; preserve publisher metadata and obtain terms before redistribution.
source_records.spatial_extent: Minnesota statewide retail electric service areas
source_records.geometry_accuracy_basis: Publisher describes PUC/utility review and ongoing boundary updates. The service metadata queried for this ledger does not provide a positional-accuracy value.

verified_query.count_meaning: Current FeatureServer feature count, not a count of utilities, grid assets, feeders, substations, or customers.

source_records.authority_quote: The digital EUSA map is the official map for the state of Minnesota, per the Commission's April 9, 2014 Order in Docket 12-957.

source_records.publisher: Minnesota Geospatial Information Office / Minnesota Department of Commerce
source_records.version_or_vintage: notice dated 2022-07-20; the canonical MnGeo page now 301-redirects to https://mn.gov/mngeo and no longer serves the notice
source_records.spatial_extent: Minnesota statewide historical transmission lines and substations
source_records.source_crs: unavailable: the dataset was withdrawn by its publisher, so no artifact and no CRS were acquired
source_records.geometry_accuracy_basis: MnGeo states that, because of existing accuracy problems and insufficient current information, Commerce cannot continue to support distribution and use of this dataset.
source_records.unavailability_reason: Publisher withdrawal for accuracy and currency; it cannot be upgraded to a current source-backed asset layer by conflation with its historical records.
source_records.canonical_url_status: 301 redirect to https://mn.gov/mngeo as of 2026-09-06; the withdrawal notice is no longer citable live
source_records.notice_quote: 7/20/2022: Given existing accuracy problems with the dataset and insufficient current information, the Minnesota Department of Commerce cannot continue to support the distribution and use of this dataset.

source_records.license_or_terms: No reusable license statement was captured from queried layer metadata; retain service attribution and verify terms before redistribution.
source_records.spatial_extent: Mille Lacs County map-service scope only; never Minnesota statewide
source_records.geometry: native MapServer point and polyline features
source_records.geometry_accuracy_basis: No numeric positional-accuracy statement was captured from the layer metadata. Geometry is source-provided, but its accuracy is source-undocumented in this ledger.

verified_layers.denominator_scope: Features returned by this source layer on 2026-09-06, not every physical substation in Mille Lacs County and not a statewide denominator.

verified_query.count_meaning: Features returned by this source layer on 2026-09-06. It is not a count of every physical asset in the county and never a statewide denominator.

verified_layers.denominator_scope: Features returned by this source layer on 2026-09-06, not every physical line in Mille Lacs County and not a statewide denominator.

verified_query.count_meaning: Features returned by this source layer on 2026-09-06. It is not a count of every physical asset in the county and never a statewide denominator.

source_records.access: public permitting index and eDockets links
source_records.spatial_extent: individual applications, certificate-of-need and route-permit records
source_records.source_crs: unavailable: CRS is a property of an individual filed exhibit and no exhibit has been acquired
source_records.geometry: may include applicant exhibits; neither a single statewide feature service nor a statewide denominator was verified

source_records.source_crs: unavailable: acquisition is restricted, so no artifact and no CRS were acquired
source_records.geometry_accuracy_basis: unavailable until an authorized artifact and its metadata are acquired
does_not_support: publicly acquired Minnesota statewide network in this repository
source_records.restriction_reason: No credentials, account request, NDA, or authorized source-owner request was used for this ledger.

source_records.spatial_extent: selected solar, wind, battery-storage and large-transmission projects in permitting context
source_records.source_crs: unavailable: the PUC publishes approximate markers in a viewer, and no downloadable artifact with a declared CRS was acquired
source_records.geometry_accuracy_basis: The PUC says markers are approximate and the map does not include all pending or permitted transmission projects.
source_records.notice_quote: Locational markers on the map show approximate locations. This map does not include all transmission projects in the PUC's permitting process or that have been permitted by the PUC.
source_records.unavailability_reason: The PUC states the markers are approximate and the map does not include all pending or permitted transmission projects, so it supplies neither native route geometry nor a project denominator. No downloadable artifact was acquired.

physical_class_coverage.reason: Official retail service-area geometry is available, but it is not a physical-network asset inventory.

physical_class_coverage.denominator_scope: No verified statewide physical-line denominator. The county service has 31 returned line features in its own scope.
physical_class_coverage.reason: Statewide source was withdrawn by its publisher for accuracy/currentness; county geometry cannot establish statewide coverage.
No current, authoritative statewide source with a verified subtransmission classification was acquired.

physical_class_coverage.denominator_scope: No verified statewide physical-substation denominator. The county service has 11 returned point features in its own scope.
physical_class_coverage.reason: County geometry is source-backed but does not supply statewide completeness or electrical terminals.
No statewide support/tower inventory with native geometry and accuracy basis was acquired.
EUSA polygons identify retail service territory only. No statewide feeder, device, terminal or distribution-connectivity source was acquired.
No source-backed terminal-to-terminal edge set was acquired. Geometry, proximity, roads, imagery and synthetic cases cannot create connectivity.
Interfaces to Manitoba, North Dakota, South Dakota, Iowa and Wisconsin require asset-specific source evidence. MISO planning/model acquisition is restricted and no authorized artifact was acquired.
